features.name: Subscription Billing
features.description: A module for creating recurring invoices on a monthly, yearly, or quarterly basis for customers or vendors with flexible billing options and contract tracking.
features.status_evidence_quote: in October we received the general availability for the first version of the app which is called subscription and recurring billing
caveats: Not created automatically with demo data

features.name: Billing Templates
features.description: Pre-configured templates that can be assigned to customers so that subscriptions do not need to be manually assigned each month.

features.name: Flexible Billing Options
features.description: Ability to invoice monthly, quarterly, in advance or at different intervals with the flexibility to preview upcoming invoices.

features.name: Contract Terms Tracking
features.description: Functionality to track and record contract terms including customer agreements, cancellation periods, timeline, amounts, and when invoicing can occur.

features.name: Revenue Deferrals
features.description: Ability to defer revenue recognition so that invoices created in advance are matched to the proper accounting period through deferral mechanisms.
caveats: Configurable per contract whether deferrals are used or not

features.name: Automated Contracts with Job Queues
features.description: Automated contract processing and subscription billing operations through job queue functionality for handling recurring billing operations.

features.name: Contoso Demo Data for Subscription Billing
features.description: Pre-populated demo data that allows users to test and explore subscription billing functionality with realistic example scenarios.
caveats: Must be explicitly generated using the Contoso demo tool

features.name: Subscription Billing Role Center
features.description: A default role center created for subscription billing functionality showing open posting documents, subscription lines, financial data, and error notifications.

features.name: Subscription Contract Setup
features.description: Configuration page for subscription contract settings including shipment vs posting date basis, overdue formula, billing base, billing rhythm, and deferral policy.

features.name: Auto-Insert Dimensions for Contracts
features.description: Feature to automatically create and assign dimension values when contracts are created, linking all transactions and details to a contract dimension.

features.name: Subscription start date selection
features.description: Choose whether subscription billing starts on shipment date or posting date when creating subscription lines with sales orders.

features.name: Subscription contract deferral settings
features.description: Configure whether deferrals are always created, never created, or created based on individual contract decisions for revenue and cost recognition.

features.name: Subscription number series
features.description: Configure number series for customer contracts, vendor contracts, and subscriptions to ensure unique sequential numbering.

features.name: Subscription invoice text generation
features.description: Configure invoice details including the name format and auto-generated text that appears on invoices created from subscription contracts.

features.name: Subscription general posting group setup
features.description: Assign accounts to customer and vendor subscription contracts for posting directly or through deferrals, including revenue and cost accrual accounts.

features.name: Contract types
features.description: Create different subscription contract types including standard contracts, maintenance contracts, equipment with maintenance, order subscriptions, support, and usage data subscriptions.

features.name: Contract harmonization
features.description: Allow adding additional subscription lines to existing contracts during the contract period while maintaining the same end date and applying harmonized billing across all lines.

features.name: Subscription packages
features.description: Define reusable subscription packages containing multiple service or product lines that can be assigned to items and used to automatically create subscription lines when items are sold.

features.name: Package customer and vendor lines
features.description: Create subscription packages with both customer and vendor lines to simultaneously purchase services and resell them to customers.

features.name: Package templates
features.description: Pre-created subscription package templates that can be reused instead of manually creating packages from scratch each time.

features.name: Subscription invoicing option
features.description: Choose whether subscription lines create invoices or are stored as information-only records not affecting company books, such as warranty information.

features.name: Subscription calculation base type
features.description: Calculate subscription value based on item price, whole document price, or price and discount, with percentage-based calculations possible.

features.name: Billing period and rhythm
features.description: Configure billing base period and billing rhythm to determine how often invoices are created and how the price is divided across billing periods.

features.name: Subscription initial and subsequent terms
features.description: Define the initial contract term length and the subsequent renewal term length, allowing extensions after the initial term ends.

features.name: Subscription notice period
features.description: Configure the notice period that customers must provide to terminate the contract, allowing automatic extension if no notice is given.

features.name: Item subscription types
features.description: Four item types available: no subscription, sales with subscription, subscription item, and invoicing item, each with different billing and creation behaviors.

features.name: Sales with subscription item type
features.description: Item type that includes a subscription package automatically when the item is sold, combining product or service with a subscription contract.

features.name: Subscription item type
features.description: Item type that creates a subscription directly without requiring a sales order, useful for services sold purely through subscriptions.

features.name: Package assignment to items
features.description: Assign subscription packages to items so that when items are sold, the package subscription lines are automatically created.

features.name: Standard vs selectable package assignment
features.description: Choose whether a package is standard (always included) or selectable (chosen at sales time) when assigning to an item.

features.name: Sales order confirmation for subscription billing
features.description: Report layout for sales order confirmation that includes subscription details like maintenance services in the printed output.

features.name: Subscription line creation on shipment
features.description: Subscription lines are automatically created when the sales order is shipped, not when the invoice is posted.

features.name: Subscription card structure
features.description: Subscription cards contain customer information and subscription-level details, with subscription lines containing charge and period details, connected to contracts for billing.

features.name: Subscription billing period configuration
features.description: Configure the billing period for individual subscription lines, such as monthly invoicing.

features.name: Contract attributes and item attributes
features.description: Subscriptions support both item attributes inherited from the subscription line item and custom attributes specific to the subscription card.

features.name: Exchange rate override in subscriptions
features.description: Exchange rates are initially copied from the original sales order but can be manually changed on the subscription if different rates are needed for billing.

features.name: Customer subscription contract
features.description: Contracts group subscription lines and define what services are charged to customers over specified periods. Contracts can contain multiple subscription lines and serve as the basis for invoice generation.
caveats: Contracts are not directly connected to projects; dimensions must be used if project tracking is needed

features.name: Contract type classification
features.description: Contracts can be divided into different types such as maintenance or support to categorize and filter billing arrangements.

features.name: Get subscription line feature
features.description: Option to retrieve and assign existing subscription lines from the subscription list to a contract, eliminating duplicate data entry.

features.name: Create billing documents from contract
features.description: Invoices are automatically created from subscription contracts with all details populated from the contract setup, and can be posted immediately.

features.name: Contract renewal quote workflow
features.description: When contracts are ending, users can create renewal quotes, convert them to sales orders, and extend contract dates with optional additional services.

features.name: Navigate posted documents and renewals
features.description: Contract navigation shows posted invoices, renewal quotes, renewal orders, and deferrals for comprehensive contract history viewing.

features.name: Direct subscription creation without sales order
features.description: Subscriptions can be created directly without a preceding sales order, allowing users to charge customers for ongoing services or contracts directly.

features.name: Subscription template selection
features.description: Predefined templates can be used when creating subscriptions to standardize pricing, quantities, and billing details for common subscription types.

features.name: Recurring billing functionality
features.description: A bulk feature allowing users to view all pending invoices across multiple contracts and create them in one operation, with filtering by contract type, user, or billing date.

features.name: Billing proposals and invoice preview
features.description: System creates proposals showing which invoices should be generated in a billing period, allowing users to review before committing to invoice creation.

features.name: Multi-contract customer invoicing
features.description: Multiple subscription contracts for the same customer can be consolidated into a single invoice or kept separate based on user preference.

features.name: Proposal deletion and document cleanup
features.description: Users can delete open invoices created from proposals and clear proposals to start fresh if corrections are needed on contracts.

features.name: Vendor subscription deferrals
features.description: Create and manage deferrals for vendor subscription contracts, dividing annual payments into monthly periods and releasing them based on the contract period.
caveats: System provides no confirmation message after release
Manual checking required to verify release was successful

features.name: Vendor subscription contract
features.description: Similar to customer subscriptions, vendor subscription contracts allow systematic invoicing and deferral management for recurring purchases from vendors.

features.name: Contract deferrals release
features.description: Release accumulated deferral amounts for specific periods, moving costs from deferral accounts to appropriate expense or revenue accounts in the correct accounting month.
caveats: No error messages provided during release process
Requires manual verification of release completion

features.name: General ledger entry visibility for deferrals
features.description: View general ledger entries showing movement of deferred amounts from deferral accounts to cost or revenue accounts by accounting period.

features.name: Usage-based subscription billing with data import
features.description: Create subscription invoices based on usage or spending data imported from vendor invoices or license purchases, using data exchange definitions to map external data to subscription items.
caveats: Vendor invoices cannot be posted automatically
Additional fields like vendor invoice number must be added manually

features.name: Data exchange definition for subscription imports
features.description: Configure data exchange definitions to standardize import format for usage or spending data, with ability to customize date and format settings per region or requirement.
caveats: Must manually create separate definitions for different regions or formats

features.name: Manual data processing for subscription imports
features.description: Process imported usage or spending data line by line to identify and resolve errors before creating subscription invoices, with detailed error reporting for troubleshooting.
caveats: Requires manual assignment of missing customers or vendors

features.name: Usage data with mid-period price changes
features.description: Handle mid-period changes in usage quantities or pricing by importing new data that creates separate invoice lines for different rate periods within the same month.
caveats: System recalculates unit price for partial-month periods

features.name: Subscription billing reports
features.description: Excel-based reports in Business Central showing deferral amounts, revenue projections, and contract details for both customer and vendor subscription contracts.

features.name: Subscription billing Power BI app
features.description: Power BI dashboard providing overview of subscription revenue, year-over-year analysis, revenue by item and customer, deferral tracking, and billing forecast.
caveats: Not connected to live system in demonstration

features.name: Proposed billing and batch posting
features.description: Generate proposed invoices from subscription contracts and post multiple invoices in batch without manually opening or reviewing each one.
